spans.s:
mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Very deep.
E.
अ neg. स्था to stand, with क्विप् affix, and ग from गम to go; where there is no proceeding to an end; it is also written अस्ताग, अस्थाघ, अस्थान and अस्थार.

mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
See the preceding.
E.
as before, with घ, from हन to kill or hurt, and अप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
See अस्थाग.
n. (-नं)
A place where there is no firm footing.
adv.
Unsuitably, unseasonably.
E.
अ neg. end, स्थान stopping.

nf. (-नं-नी)
An assembly.
n. (-नं)
1 Place, site.
2 Staying, abiding.
3 Pains, care.
E.
आङ्, स्था to stay or stand, ल्युट् and ङीप् affs.

ind.
Unseasonably, inopportunely.
E.
अ neg. स्थाने in place.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
See अस्थाग; also अस्थाव and अस्थास.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Perishable, transient.
E.
अ neg. and स्थायिन् staying.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
See अस्थाग.
E.
अस्था as above, and र from रा to obtain.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Moveable, moving, not fixed.
2 (In law) Personal, (as property) money, cattle, &c. opposed to land.
E.
अ neg. स्थावर stable.

n. (-स्थि)
A bone.
E.
अस to throw, &c. and क्थिन् aff.

n. (-कं)
A bone.
E.
कन added to the last.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Marrow.
E.
अस्थि a bone, and कृत् what makes.

m. (-जः)
Marrow.
E.
अस्थि and ज what is produced.

m. (-ज्ञः)
Marrow.
E.
अस्थि and ज्ञ what knows.

f. (-तिः)
Want of place or condition, want of firm continuance.
E.
अ neg. स्थिति staying.

mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डा)
A bird.
E.
अस्थि and तुण्ड a mouth; whose mouth or beak is of bone.

m. (-दः)
Pain in the bones.
E.
अस्थि and तोद torturing.

f. (-त्वक्)
The periosteum.
E.
अस्थि and त्वच् skin.

m. (-न्वा)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
अस्थि, धनु a bow, and अच् aff.

m. (-रः)
A skeleton.
E.
अस्थि and पञ्जर a cage.

m. (-क्षः)
A dog.
E.
अस्थि and भक्ष who eats.

Fracture.
2

A plant of supposed efficacy in fractures, (Cissus quadrangularis.)
E.
अस्थि and भङ्ग a breaking.

m. (-भुक्)
A dog.
E.
अस्थि a bone, भुज् who eats.

m. (-दः)
1 Fracturing, breaking or wounding a bone.
2 A sort of bone, a bone.
E.
अस्थि and भेद breaking, &c.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A bone-breaker, who or what breaks bones.
E.
अस्थि and भेदक what breaks.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Having bones, vertebrated, &c.
E.
अस्थि and मतुप् poss. aff.

f. (-ला)
A necklace of bones.
E.
अस्थि and माला a garland.

m. (-ली)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
अस्थि a bone, माला a garland, इनि affix; ŚIVA is commonly represented with a necklace of skulls.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Trembling, shaken, unsteady.
2 Uncertain, unascertained.
3 Unworthy of confidence.
E.
अ neg. and स्थिर firm.

f. (-ता)
Unsteadiness, fickleness, mutability.
E.
अस्थिर and तल aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Unsteadiness, mutability.
E.
अस्थिर and त्व aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Bony, osseous.
E.
अस्थि and वतुप् aff.

m. (-हः)
A name of BHṚṄGI, one of ŚIVA'S attendants.
E.
अस्थि and विग्रह a part, &c. who carries ŚIVA'S decorations.

m. (-षः)
Dryness and decay of the bones.
E.
अस्थि and शोष drying up.

m. (-रः)
A plant, a species of turnsole^1, (Heliotropium indicum): see हस्तिशुण्डी.
E.
अस्थि and सं before हृ to take, to collect, seize, &c. (it is an ingredient in philtres, &c.) अण aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-कः)
The adjutant bird.
E.
अस्थि and संहारक who seizes.

m. (-यः)
Collecting the bones or their ashes after burning a corpse.
E.
अस्थि and सञ्चय assemblage; also अस्थिसञ्चायनं^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 301.

f. (-न्धिः)
1 A joint, an articulation.
2 Uniting of a broken bone.
E.
अस्थि and सन्धि connection.

n. (-णं)
Throwing the bones of a dead body into the Ganges.
E.
अस्थि and समर्पण consigning.

m. (-रः)
Marrow.
E.
अस्थि bone, and सार essence.

m. (-णः)
The body, or that of which the bones are the supporters.
E.
अस्थि and स्थूण a post.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Small, delicate.
E.
अ neg. स्थूल gross.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Instability, unsteadiness.
E.
अ neg. स्थैर्य्य steadiness.

f. (-स्था)
1 Prop, stay, place or means of abiding.
2 An assembly.
3 Effort, pains, care.
4 Consideration, regard.
E.
आङ् before स्था to stay, to stand, आङ् and टाप् affs.

n. (-नं)
1 Placing, fixing, causing to stay or remain.
2 An enema of oil, ghee, &c.
E.
आङ् before स्था to stay, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Stayed, dwelt, abiding, abode.
2 Applied to, having recourse to.
3 Occupied, engrossed by, engaged in.
4 Spread, overspread.
5

Obtained.
6

Observing, adhering to, following, practising.
E.
आङ् before स्था and क्त aff.
